text:
Qasim Malik is a product manager at HealthSphere Innovations, a healthtech company focused on advancing digital solutions for healthcare providers. With two years of experience in the industry, he brings a structured approach to product development, emphasizing clarity, collaboration, and measurable outcomes. His work centers on aligning technical execution with user needs, particularly in complex environments like telehealth and clinical workflows.  

At HealthSphere, Qasim has led the design and launch of a telehealth platform that increased patient engagement by 35% within its first year. He leverages Agile/Scrum frameworks to manage cross-functional teams, ensuring timely delivery while maintaining high-quality standards. His competitive analysis of market trends has informed product roadmaps, enabling the team to prioritize features that address gaps in existing solutions.  

Qasim’s analytical rigor extends to SQL-driven insights, which he uses to refine product strategies and validate hypotheses. He collaborates closely with stakeholders, including clinicians and administrators, to translate feedback into actionable improvements. His focus remains on creating tools that simplify healthcare operations without compromising usability or compliance.  

Driven by the potential of technology to solve real-world challenges, Qasim continues to explore ways to enhance the intersection of innovation and care delivery.
